card.name: All-caps label and warning words
card.fires_on: Capitalised pieces of all-caps words that start a heading or warning, such as IN-STRUCTIONS, DO NOT, WARNING, or IN-TRAMUSCULAR. It fires at the start of the capitalised word, often right after a sentence ends.

modes.label: INSTRUCTIONS FOR USE heading
modes.description: The STRUCTIONS piece of the all-caps heading INSTRUCTIONS FOR USE after a syringe section title.

modes.label: DO NOT warning
modes.description: The capitalised DO that begins a DO NOT command after a sentence about handling a vial or syringe.
modes.example: c. Gently swirl the EPKINLY vial.<< DO>> NOT invert, vortex, or vigorously shake

modes.label: Other all-caps starts
modes.description: Pieces of other capitalised terms such as WARNING, a route heading, or a brand name.

card.plain: It marks the start of shouted all-capital headings and warnings in drug labels, like DO NOT or INSTRUCTIONS.
